notes: Certain flashes/patterns can trigger seizures in a person with reported photosensitivity. A movie-specific veto is our cautious implementation; warning intensity and playback cut are not verified.

Evidence-insufficient exclusion, NOT a claim that the film contains flashing. Current 'none' values are only low-confidence community reports, not version-verified clearance. The source does not require this unknown-data policy.

source: S02: MPA; S03: BBFC; S04: CBFC
notes: These named classifications are adult-restricted in their respective systems. Apply only to the published classification and retain its country/version; rating alone does not guarantee general suitability.

MPA R ordinarily permits under-17 viewers with an adult. Because guardian information was deliberately removed, this prototype chooses the stricter under-17 veto; it is NOT an absolute legal prohibition.
BBFC does not permit viewers under 15 for the named cinema/home classification. Kept for future catalog additions although current films do not have this rating.

BBFC 12 prohibits under-12 home viewing; 12A cinema allows under-12 viewers with adults. Without guardian/release-platform fields the prototype conservatively excludes both, explicitly an inference for 12A.
MPA strongly cautions parents about material for children under 13; it is an advisory, not an automatic ban. The -0.14 score weight is our adjustable design choice.
Legacy UA calls for parental guidance for children below 12; the original UA is not silently converted into a newer UA 7+/13+/16+ band. Weight is a heuristic.

Honor the person's explicit refusal when a corresponding positive warning exists (e.g., bereavement, self_harm, medical_procedure). This is an opt-in patient-choice policy, not a blanket clinical prohibition. Missing warning tags do not prove absence.

source: S06: NCI fatigue; S11: NCI side effects
notes: Fatigue can reduce energy, but no medical source sets a 120-minute movie cutoff. The threshold and -0.17 weight are our conservative comfort heuristics, not treatment advice.
Cognitive difficulty may affect sustained attention; a preference for a simpler plot is an inference. All complexity labels are subjective and LOW-confidence; -0.12 is intentionally modest.

source: S08: NHS migraine; S11: NCI side effects
notes: The sources discuss nausea but do NOT state that vomiting scenes worsen it. The movie-content link and -0.16 penalty are our explicit comfort inference.

source: S08: NHS migraine; S01: Epilepsy Foundation
notes: Light sensitivity may cause discomfort but is NOT the same as a photosensitive seizure trigger. This is a soft penalty unless the patient separately reports the seizure trigger.

Threat scenes may be unwelcome to someone who reports fear sensitivity. Threat intensity is a LOW-confidence curator estimate, so the weight is intentionally small; this is not a source-stated movie rule.

Do not promise a required viewing feature without verified availability. Current entries are all unknown; exclude as EVIDENCE INSUFFICIENT, not proven unavailable. Subtitles are not automatically equivalent to full SDH captions.
Do not promise required audio description with unknown provider/cut/track availability. Exclude as EVIDENCE INSUFFICIENT, not proven unavailable.
